cohort: 798 children at 3.5 years of age from two French nationwide birth cohorts, EPIPAGE 2 (very preterm children) and ELFE (late preterm and full-term children)
finding: Multiple early life exposures, particularly gestational age, mode of delivery, and human milk exposure, were associated with gut microbiota characteristics at 3.5 years of age.
mod_finding: Children born by cesarean section harbored lower richness and diversity and a different overall gut microbiota composition independently of preterm status.
